summary: Re-derived the homily against both studies as they stand after the concise study's derive-synthesis iteration 2 repair (which changed nothing the homily relies on), and revised it in place. In sections/homily/10-homily.tex the Gradual-Gospel and Gradual-Offertory joins are now drawn in the preacher's voice, the physician is credited to Augustine as Aquinas reports him (In Ps. 33 n. 10; De serm. Dom. II.17.58, both read at their registered loci), Augustine's upward count of the gifts and his n. 15 answer are stated, Basil on fear is tied to the promise by his own reading of non est inopia, and the close gives one response said once and states the conclusion once (clearing the iteration-1 review advisories HOM-007 to HOM-010). The terminal note, References and PDF subject follow; the revision timestamp was refreshed; research/production-review.md records the iteration (1,367 spoken words, about 10.5-11.4 minutes by arithmetic, not timed). Built with make doc: 4 pages, no warnings, fonts embedded, PDF SHA-256 a6630b389583e729bbaa18103fb48364e2767d47485ecbddeb4ddbef4d3bc2ac; every homily preflight check and the content and artifacts component checks pass (the artifacts snapshot and publication-inventory hashes are stale as expected until the build and publication stages). Upstream defect for the research and study owners: the expansive study (sections/40-no-want-just-in-gods-hand.tex), the concise study (sections/concise/10-commentary.tex), research/scope.md and research/interpretations.md credit the physician answer to Aquinas, whereas Aquinas reports it as Augustine's; the argument is unaffected. This dispatch contributed the revised homily for oral clarity and accurate attribution, with its note, References and production record.
